module: Priority 4: MCHE and 4E-40 Thermal Hydraulic Reconstruction

subcooler_4e40_findings.conclusion: 4E-40 safely unloads 0.45-0.70 MW of liquid subcooling duty from MCHE warm end.

mche_pinch_diagnostics.verdict: ZERO_TEMPERATURE_CROSSOVER_AT_BASELOAD. Legacy crossovers were pure mathematical artifacts of subtracting MW shortfall from degC.

turndown_behavior_explanation.reheat_valve_active: 4TV-510 modulates at turndown (P1-P25) to prevent suction drum TAL (-45 C trip).
turndown_behavior_explanation.suction_telemetry_effect: DCS tag H4TI004B measures post-reheat temperature (-18 to -28 C), creating apparent narrow warm approach against -32 C inlet.
turndown_behavior_explanation.physical_shell_reality: Within MCHE tube bundle, shell vaporization is bounded and safe.
